correctness.rationale: The exact finite-game claim was reconstructed from the audited graph and verifier. The source tree defines a 16-vertex, 30-edge two-layer generalized Mycielski graph. The inspected minimax code implements the literal alternating quantifiers: Alice positions are existential over legal moves and Bob positions universal from Alice's perspective; a full legal coloring is accepting and an uncolored vertex seeing all palette colors is rejecting. The only quotients are ten verified dihedral automorphisms and global color permutations. In this audit the C++17 verifier was freshly compiled and run without a cutoff: three colors returned Alice_win=0 after 241 canonical states and four colors returned Alice_win=1 after 3,734,489 canonical states. Thus \(\chi_g(M_2(C_5))=4\).
